Telangana Police Book Andhra Pradesh Police Over Alleged Offense

Telangana police have registered a case against police personnel from Andhra Pradesh. The case reportedly involves an alleged attempt to outrage the modesty of a woman. The incident has led to inter-state police action and potential friction between the two state police forces.
